name: Chancellor's Scholarship for Postgraduate (Coursework) Students
summary: Up to $4,000 for Griffith postgraduate coursework students facing educational disadvantage.
key: Maximum $4,000, paid at $500 per 10 credit points each enrolled trimester.
who: Griffith postgraduate (coursework) student, commencing or continuing.
Demonstrate educational disadvantage based on a comprehensive assessment by the University.
Australian citizen, permanent resident, permanent humanitarian visa holder or New Zealand citizen.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: Rounds close 21 December 2026, 27 January 2027, 15 March 2027 (4pm) and 30 June 2027 (11:59pm).
